A user keyword packages a sequence of steps under a readable name. It can take
arguments, document itself, and hand a value back with **`RETURN`**. Good
keywords read as action phrases — `Discounted Price`, not `dp` — so the tests
that call them read as sentences.

## Task 1 — Write a user keyword that returns a value

**Goal:** in `checks/keywords.robot`, write a `Discounted Price` keyword that
takes a price and an optional discount percent and returns the discounted price,
plus tests that call it with and without the discount.

Here is a keyword of the same shape over different arithmetic — adding tax.
Adapt its structure; the math is yours to change.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Test Cases ***
Adds Ten Percent Tax
    ${total}=    With Tax    100    10
    Should Be Equal As Numbers    ${total}    110

*** Keywords ***
With Tax
    [Documentation]    Add a percentage tax to an amount.
    [Arguments]    ${amount}    ${percent}
    ${result}=    Evaluate    ${amount} * (1 + ${percent} / 100)
    RETURN    ${result}
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `checks/keywords.robot` defines the user keyword `Discounted Price`,
and calling it with a discount passes.

<!-- hint -->
In `*** Keywords ***`, declare `Discounted Price` with
`[Arguments]    ${price}    ${percent}=0` — the `=0` makes the discount optional.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Compute the result with `Evaluate    ${price} * (1 - ${percent} / 100)` and hand
it back with `RETURN    ${result}`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Call it two ways: `Discounted Price    100` (uses the default 0) and
`Discounted Price    100    50` (half off).
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Test Cases ***
Full Price With No Discount
    ${price}=    Discounted Price    100
    Should Be Equal As Numbers    ${price}    100

Half Price
    ${price}=    Discounted Price    100    50
    Should Be Equal As Numbers    ${price}    50

*** Keywords ***
Discounted Price
    [Documentation]    Apply a percentage discount to a price.
    [Arguments]    ${price}    ${percent}=0
    ${result}=    Evaluate    ${price} * (1 - ${percent} / 100)
    RETURN    ${result}
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Call it with and without the optional argument

Run it:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

One test uses the default (`0`), one passes `50`.

**Check:** the test `Half Price` passes.
